Hi,

I saw your opening for a Graphic Designer at Naukripay group in Nagpur and wanted to reach out directly regarding your digital and print collateral needs.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I have designed over 100 digital and print creatives, including marketing materials, banners, and presentations. I also built reusable design systems that cut turnaround times for our marketing and communications work.

You can view my work in my Bounceless case study, which demonstrates my approach to clean visual execution: https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to take on this role locally. Could we take a brief look at one of my layout projects this week?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
